records.title: To Use or not to Use Muon: How Simplicity Bias in Optimizers Matters
records.reason: Optimizer inductive bias and generalization in neural-network training; no LLM inference or serving efficiency.

records.title: Toward Personalized LLM-Powered Agents: Foundations, Evaluation, and Future Directions
records.reason: Survey/taxonomy of personalization capabilities and evaluation, not a concrete inference-efficiency technique.

records.title: SuperLocalMemory: Privacy-Preserving Multi-Agent Memory with Bayesian Trust Defense Against Memory Poisoning
records.reason: SQLite/FTS5 and trust controls target agent-memory security/retrieval; reported 10.6 ms median search and no LLM inference calls for adaptive ranking. No measured model decode/KV/serving-cost reduction; linked memory relation is real but efficiency benefit is weak, so compare against existing methods.

records.title: Towards On-Policy SFT: Distribution Discriminant Theory and its Applications in LLM Training
records.reason: IDFT and Hinted Decoding align training data/model distributions and improve SFT generalization; decoding is for training-data alignment, not serving-time speculative decoding.

records.title: Covo-Audio Technical Report
records.reason: The primary abstract claims decoupling intelligence from voice rendering to reduce LALM deployment cost, plausibly relevant to serving. Primary full text returned only a stub, so system design and cost measurements cannot be verified; retain borderline pending readable primary text.
